title: Pinnacle · lumbar 3wk — the easy modern payer

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Nadia, how has the lower back been since we started treatment?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: A little better in the mornings, but it still burns down my right leg by the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: You have stayed with the physical therapy program?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, three weeks of physical therapy so far with the Riverside clinic.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good. Ask them to send over their session notes, please. Now the safety questions: any numbness in the saddle area, trouble with bladder or bowel, fevers, or weight loss?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: And your coverage is Pinnacle, right?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, Pinnacle Care through the exchange.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: With the radicular pain persisting, I think we should get an MRI of the lumbar spine.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Okay. Will they cover it this time?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: The system is checking Pinnacle's actual behavior as we speak. Sit tight.
